notes: scan048.N1: Formula (10) describes the objects X_{Delta_r} by tuples, flags and coproducts. Formula (11) defines the index notation through Hom of ordered sets and gives the X_{i_*} convention. These written assertions were carried as mathematical background while reading, not proved.

scan048.N2: The later prose invokes the composition homomorphism (9) to view the X_{Delta_r} as components of a half-simplicial space, then begins the description of an induced alpha-star map. This narrative and the displayed direction of the map were carried as background without an independent proof.

scan048.N3: Twenty-one main text/display lines were visually read, counting the separate soit prompt as a line; the additional stacked condition row, the three right-hand gloss lines, and the lower foliation were also read. The whole image and each supplied half were inspected once, then each of fifteen saved crops once. Every word and symbol was compared with both witnesses, including agreements. No OCR, research, other-page report/image or TeX compilation was used.

scan048.N4: Literal mathematical irregularities remain: the first line of (10) reads x_0≤...x_r with no second ≤, and the last factor is I_i(Delta_{r-1}), not I_{i_0}. Mathematics does not license adding the missing relation or changing that subscript. The new inner brace in the second row is an actual-ink correction to both witnesses.

scan048.N6: All three supplied marks remain undecided. scan048.N10: The right-hand gloss begins ens des, with drapeaux alone underlined, then longueur r de I. H’s repeated I(Delta_r), colon, stop after ens and final stop are each separately reported. The entire actual gloss is kept beside the first definition using the existing matrix arrangement and inventoried as a margin note.

scan048.N11. First-pass accounting, retained as history; the final reconciled totals are in the changes summary and this report’s counts object. Compiler-facing counts follow diff_c/diff_h, including explicitly tentative preferences. Twenty-four report entries contain twenty-three disagreement locations and one certainty-only row. There are five C disagreements, of which two are secure and three tentative; twenty-two H disagreements, of which eighteen are secure and four tentative. The uncertainty-only r subscript row is not counted as a textual disagreement.

scan048.N12: The three equivalence signs in (10) each show one wavy upper component and one lower bar; closed/retraced left portions of the upper wave do not establish a second wave. They remain simeq. Two tiny isolated specks above the left Delta in (12) do not form a recoverable exponent or text and are not transcribed.

scan048.N13: Main-reader targeted structural check, using the pair-order definition on scan047: a chain ((x_0,i_0),...,(x_r,i_r)) has one common x and i_0≤...≤i_r. Since the pieces increase along the order, x in X_{i_0} implies membership in each later piece. This gives the flag/coproduct description on the intended chain reading. The written first row omits one ≤, so that literal condition is incomplete. For r≥1 the last coproduct can be regrouped by i_0 with the remaining length-r flag in I_{i_0}; the printed I_i leaves i unbound. At r=0 the displayed Delta_{r-1} would require a convention for Delta_{-1}, not supplied here. These are qualifications in the notes only; no relation, subscript or convention is supplied in the transcription.

scan048.N14: Blind adjudication leaves the first r doubtful without reconstructing a star or old glyph, retains the distinct dot before X_i* in (10), and preserves the brace/parenthesis and ou/d-ou alternatives. Composition and simplicial are supported by their internal strokes. Etant remains live. The compressed final une is now marked with un as an alternative. All whole formulas were compared, and the visible index irregularities discussed in N13 stand unchanged.
